messages:
tara: posted 4 photos  meet Pickle, the office mini-dachshund who just discovered pumpkins. apparently pumpkins are for sitting on now. https://img.redwood.internal/tara/pickle-1.jpg https://img.redwood.internal/tara/pickle-2.jpg

liam: this is officially the best Q4 kickoff content i've seen. tiny legs, big personality. :rofl::pumpkin:

nina: is he upset about the squash hierarchy or just very regal? :crown::paw_prints:

tara: 100% regal. he hopped onto the biggest pumpkin and refused to move until he got a ham snack. 

ops-bot: reminder: office kitchen closed 12-1pm for fridge cleaning. pick up any perishables. :wastebasket:

liam: ops-bot trying to deflate Pickle's throne hour. :sweat_smile:

nina: caption contest: "release notes: added pumpkin affinity" or "when your pod gets scheduled on a different node"

tara: adding one more  video of him doing the head-tilt. it's a performance review in emoji. https://img.redwood.internal/tara/pickle-vid.mp4

giphy-bot: https://giphy.com/gifs/dachshund-pumpkin-cute-1g0Q7q0g 

liam: vote: office pumpkin throne for next all-hands stage? :raised_hands: :ballot_box_with_ballot:

nina: yes. also small dog treats will be provided by logistics. :cookie:

tara: thanks for the love. Pickle approves all deployment plans that include snacks.
